KEEP IT ON

Description

Awakened by mysterious sounds in the woods, you realize your camping trip is no longer safe. Something is out there, and it’s getting closer. As the only one awake, you must identify the threat and shield your friends from the danger approaching from the shadows. Every sound is a clue; every shadow is a threat. Can you save them all?

WASD Movement between positions
F Flashlight

Polygonetwo5 days ago

The game saying to press enter when it really means space is strange, but the controls otherwise work. To look behind you, you have to press S while looking straight ahead, not at one of your friend's tents. W to look forward again. That said, sometimes when the monster is scared away the kid dies anyway, which is both annoying and a godsend. Most of the challenge of the game comes from your 'friends' not knowing how to shut up and interrupting you every two seconds. That said, it gets notably easier once they're all dead. No more interruptions, and only two places the monster could be. Who needs friends anyway? At the least not ones with zero survival instinct.

I played this game for a video on my channel, but unfortunately I don't think I'll be posting it as I don't want to shed negative light on it or the dev. I would love to play it again if the dev fixed that one bug.

Yo, thank you! Whenever I post games, I always look for videos from you first. Yeah our friends are a bit idiots, just like us in general. I agree that the controls are complicated and the game is overall too intense in terms of fast-paced action. I just thought it wouldn’t be enough when I tested it, and I guess I overdid it. I’ll release a patch soon and make the game a bit easier. Yeah, I was inspired a bit by FNAF 4 with its flashlight-searching mechanics and FNAF 2 with its flashlight-flashing scare mechanic.

Thanks again for the video and the kind words! Good luck on YouTube, bro!
